items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: Dave was out of his hands on everything that was released on Imperial. Everybody records for Imperial. Dave wouldn't record it unless you put your name on it.

ctx.x: Dave was out of his hands on it?
